comment: GENERATED by bin/curate/gen_unit_acceptance_docs.py from `choupoSolve --describe-units` and `choupoBatch --describe-units` (the one home: each unit's acceptance() declaration).  Do not edit; regenerate.

FUG.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the feed, at the constant relative volatilities of the feed bubble point (Fenske-Underwood-Gilliland); no azeotrope is representable, and the model is a declared approximation, recorded on every run.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

absorber.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: The declared solvent (held in the liquid, never evaporated), every `role solute` component that has a Henry pair against it (moved between the phases by the Kremser cascade), and every other gas component as an insoluble carrier that leaves in the gas.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: The gas feed inlet carrying something that is not a vapour -- The Kremser cascade carries the gas as a vapour and takes its flow and heat capacity as such; a liquid fed to this port would be counted as gas.

The liquid wash inlet carrying something that is not a liquid -- The Kremser cascade holds the solvent in the liquid (it never evaporates) and takes this stream's flow and heat capacity as a liquid's; a vapour fed to this port would be counted as liquid.

A feed failing `noSolvent` -- The Kremser method here reads HENRY'S LAW, not the activity model -- a `gammaPhi` package with UNIFAC or NRTL carries no answer it can use -- and it needs a package that names a SOLVENT to tell which component washes and which is washed out.  With no solvent every component is inert, so the gas would leave unchanged and the liquid stream would vanish.

A feed failing `noSolute` -- A component transfers only when its record declares `role solute;` AND a Henry pair <component>-<solvent> exists.  With no such component there is nothing to transfer: the gas would leave unchanged and the liquid stream would vanish, which is an answer only in the sense that it is a number.

A feed failing `soluteWithoutHenryPair` -- A component is transferred only when its record declares `role solute;` AND a Henry pair against the solvent exists.  A solute with no pair is not transferred -- the cascade would carry it through as an inert, in silence, and report a gas it never washed (or a liquid it never stripped) at exit 0.

A feed failing `nonSoluteInTheLiquid` -- The cascade moves SOLUTES (`role solute;` with a Henry pair against the solvent) between the phases, holds the solvent in the liquid and every other component in the gas.  It has no rule for a non-solute that arrives in the LIQUID (absorbed, stripped or carried through are three different answers, and Kremser makes none of them), so that component would leave in neither outlet.  A TRACE (below 1e-12 of the stream) is carried through.

adiabaticFlash.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the feed, split among the phases the package's equilibrium finds at the outlet pressure and the inlet's enthalpy (a vapour, one or two liquids, and any solid phase the case declares).
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

batchCrystalliser.judged: the vessel's initial holdup, in its initialise -- choupoBatch has no pre-solve pass
models: Every component the stream carries.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed failing `crystallisableSolute` -- A crystalliser needs a solute whose saturation the package can compute: the package's electrolyte salt, or a component with a `solubility {}` curve.
A feed failing `volatileCarrier` -- The saturation is a solute mass per mass of a SOLVENT, a volatile carrier (water, an alcohol).

batchDiafilter.judged: the vessel's initial holdup, in its initialise -- choupoBatch has no pre-solve pass
models: The aqueous solvent (water unless the case declares another) and the solutes the case declares `role nonvolatile;`, each with its own permeance.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed carrying no aqueous solvent -- the transport laws in this tree assume an aqueous carrier and price the solvent flux on it.
A component outside what it models -- any other component would never permeate -- it would stay in the vessel whole, through every diavolume, with no permeance and no word said.

batchElectrodialysis.judged: the vessel's initial holdup, in its initialise -- choupoBatch has no pre-solve pass
models: The aqueous solvent and the IONS -- every other component must cross its declared component -> species bridge (`aqueousMapping`) to ONE aqueous species with a record in the species catalogue.
At least one of them besides the solvent.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed carrying no aqueous solvent -- electrodialysis needs an aqueous carrier: the molality closure and the conductivity are both built on it.
A component outside what it models -- the rig's transport is written ion by ion: a component that is not one ion has no charge, no diffusivity and no share of the current.
A feed carrying none of the components it acts on -- A tank with no ion carries no current -- nothing to transport.  REMEDY: charge the tank with its ions.
needs: `aqueousActivityModel` -- The Nernst membrane potential is a function of the aqueous activities, and choosing their model is the case's: no default is applied.

column.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of every feed, equilibrated stage by stage on the package's K-values under constant molar overflow (a nonvolatile, K = 0, goes to the bottoms); the stage energy balance is NOT solved by the CMO method (the full MESH route solves it), and a Murphree efficiency only where declared (`model rateBased;`: a binary packed bed at total reflux, as non-equilibrium segments).
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

compressor.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the suction, as one vapour mixture priced by the package's enthalpy and entropy.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed that is not a vapour -- A compressor is a vapour machine: its isentropic path (`H_real`, `S_real`) is the VAPOUR root at the overall composition, so a liquid or two-phase suction would be compressed as if it were all vapour while the energy report, resolving the same stream, finds the latent heat of its liquid unaccounted (slugging, erosion and a broken valve plate in a real machine).

crystalliser.judged: the combined feed it makes of its inlets
models: Every component the stream carries.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed failing `crystallisableSolute` -- A crystalliser needs a solute whose saturation the package can compute: the package's electrolyte salt, or a component with a `solubility {}` curve.
A feed failing `volatileCarrier` -- The saturation is a solute mass per mass of a SOLVENT, a volatile carrier (water, an alcohol).

distillationColumn.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of every feed, equilibrated stage by stage on the package's K-values under constant molar overflow (a nonvolatile, K = 0, goes to the bottoms); the stage energy balance is NOT solved by the CMO method (the full MESH route solves it), and a Murphree efficiency only where declared (`model rateBased;`: a binary packed bed at total reflux, as non-equilibrium segments).
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

electrodialysisStack.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: The aqueous solvent and the IONS -- every other component must cross its declared component -> species bridge (`aqueousMapping`) to ONE aqueous species with a record in the species catalogue.
At least one of them besides the solvent.
mayPass: A component it does not model, when the case DECLARES it: `passThrough { <component> { fate diluate | concentrate; }  reason "..."; }` -- A fate is the outlet that carries ALL of the component the stack is fed, both channels together.  No split fraction is offered: dividing a component between the channels is a transfer across the membranes, a partition the declaration says the stack does not perform -- a fraction would be a fitted number with no mechanism behind it.  A fate that moves a component out of the channel it was fed in is the case's claim, and the run prints the amount.
refuses: A feed carrying no aqueous solvent -- electrodialysis needs an aqueous carrier: the molalities, the channel conductivities and the Nernst potentials are all built on it.
A component outside what it models -- the stack's transport is written ion by ion: a component that is not one ion has no charge, no diffusivity and no share of the Faraday transfer.
A feed carrying none of the components it acts on -- A channel with no ion carries no current -- nothing to transport.  REMEDY: feed the channel its ions.
needs: `aqueousActivityModel` -- The Nernst membrane potential and the channel conductivities are computed from aqueous activities, and choosing their model is the case's: no default is applied.

evaporator.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: One volatile solvent (the single feed component whose role is `volatile` or `solute`), evaporated, and every other component as a nonvolatile solute that stays in the concentrate and raises its boiling point.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed failing `oneVolatileSolvent` -- This single-effect model evaporates ONE solvent: with two volatile components the vapour would be a mixture whose composition the unit has no equilibrium for, and with none there is nothing to evaporate.  (Wine, with its ethanol, is two volatiles.).

extract.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of both streams, split between the extract and the raffinate by the package's liquid-liquid equilibrium at the column's one temperature.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: The feed inlet carrying something that is not a liquid -- The cascade equilibrates LIQUID against liquid on the package's liquid-liquid model, at one temperature and with no energy balance; a vapour fed to it would enter the stage balances as if it were a liquid.

The solvent inlet carrying something that is not a liquid -- The cascade equilibrates LIQUID against liquid on the package's liquid-liquid model, at one temperature and with no energy balance; a vapour fed to it would enter the stage balances as if it were a liquid.

extractor.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of both streams, split between the extract and the raffinate by the package's liquid-liquid equilibrium at the column's one temperature.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: The feed inlet carrying something that is not a liquid -- The cascade equilibrates LIQUID against liquid on the package's liquid-liquid model, at one temperature and with no energy balance; a vapour fed to it would enter the stage balances as if it were a liquid.

The solvent inlet carrying something that is not a liquid -- The cascade equilibrates LIQUID against liquid on the package's liquid-liquid model, at one temperature and with no energy balance; a vapour fed to it would enter the stage balances as if it were a liquid.

flash.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the feed, split among the phases the package's equilibrium finds at the specified conditions (a vapour, one or two liquids, and any solid phase the case declares); a nonvolatile stays in the liquid (K = 0).
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

heatExchanger.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of both streams, by the effectiveness-NTU method on a constant heat capacity per stream (re-evaluated at its mean temperature); a phase change inside the exchanger is not modelled by the eps-NTU relation -- the outlet is re-resolved at the package's equilibrium and the change is announced.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

ionExchanger.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: The aqueous solvent and the IONS of a water analysis (Ca, Mg, Na, K, Cl, SO4, HCO3, ...) -- every other component must cross its declared component -> species bridge (`aqueousMapping`) to ONE aqueous species with a record in the species catalogue.
At least one of them besides the solvent.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed carrying no aqueous solvent -- a softener exchanges the ions of an AQUEOUS solution: the speciation and the resin equilibrium are written on molalities in the aqueous carrier.
A component outside what it models -- the speciation and the resin equilibrium are written ion by ion; a component that is not one ion has no place in either.
A feed carrying none of the components it acts on -- A softener needs a water analysis to soften.  REMEDY: feed the water's ions.
needs: `aqueousActivityModel` -- The speciation and the exchange equilibrium are written on aqueous activities, and choosing their model is the case's: no default is applied.

isothermalFlash.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the feed, split among the phases the package's equilibrium finds at the specified conditions (a vapour, one or two liquids, and any solid phase the case declares); a nonvolatile stays in the liquid (K = 0).
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

membraneSW.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: The aqueous solvent (water unless the case declares another) and the solutes the case declares `role nonvolatile;`, each with its own permeance.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed carrying no aqueous solvent -- this module's transport and its outlet closure are written for an AQUEOUS feed -- the solvent permeates, the nonvolatile solutes are rejected.
A component outside what it models -- any other component would leave in NEITHER outlet, its mass re-counted as the solvent.

mixer.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of every inlet, summed; the outlet is the package's equilibrium at the outlet pressure, at the temperature that closes the adiabatic balance or at the declared one (then the duty it implies is published and the outlet carries the dominant phase's label).
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

pressureExchanger.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component the two streams carry, each with a liquid molar volume or an aqueous bridge (a dissolved solute, whose volume is then the solvent's).
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed that is not a liquid -- The exchanger moves pressure between two LIQUIDS by displacement in a duct: its balances are volumetric on the liquid molar volume, and a vapour has no duct volume to exchange.

A feed carrying no aqueous solvent -- the device is the seawater-RO energy-recovery device: both streams are aqueous solutions, the salinity it moves between them is the solute mass fraction on the aqueous solvent, and a dissolved solute's volume is taken as the solvent's.

pump.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component the stream carries.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed that is not a liquid -- The pump model is the incompressible one, W = v dP / eta on the LIQUID molar volume, and its outlet is a liquid; a vapour fed to it would be priced on a volume it does not have (and a real pump fed vapour loses its prime).

shortcutColumn.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the feed, at the constant relative volatilities of the feed bubble point (Fenske-Underwood-Gilliland); no azeotrope is representable, and the model is a declared approximation, recorded on every run.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

models: The aqueous solvent (water unless the case declares another) and the solutes the case declares `role nonvolatile;`, each with its own permeance.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed carrying no aqueous solvent -- this module's transport and its outlet closure are written for an AQUEOUS feed -- the solvent permeates, the nonvolatile solutes are rejected.
A component outside what it models -- any other component would leave in NEITHER outlet, its mass re-counted as the solvent.

splitter.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the inlet, divided by ONE fraction per outlet: it separates nothing, so every outlet has the inlet's composition, temperature and pressure.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.

stripper.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: The declared solvent (held in the liquid, never evaporated), every `role solute` component that has a Henry pair against it (stripped out of the liquid by the Kremser cascade), and every other gas component as an inert carrier that leaves in the gas.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: The rich liquid inlet carrying something that is not a liquid -- The Kremser cascade holds the solvent in the liquid (it never evaporates) and takes this stream's flow and heat capacity as a liquid's; a vapour fed to this port would be counted as liquid.

The stripping gas inlet carrying something that is not a vapour -- The Kremser cascade carries the gas as a vapour and takes its flow and heat capacity as such; a liquid fed to this port would be counted as gas.

A feed failing `noSolvent` -- The Kremser method here reads HENRY'S LAW, not the activity model -- a `gammaPhi` package with UNIFAC or NRTL carries no answer it can use -- and it needs a package that names a SOLVENT to tell which component washes and which is washed out.  With no solvent every component is inert, so the gas would leave unchanged and the liquid stream would vanish.

A feed failing `noSolute` -- A component transfers only when its record declares `role solute;` AND a Henry pair <component>-<solvent> exists.  With no such component there is nothing to transfer: the gas would leave unchanged and the liquid stream would vanish, which is an answer only in the sense that it is a number.

A feed failing `soluteWithoutHenryPair` -- A component is transferred only when its record declares `role solute;` AND a Henry pair against the solvent exists.  A solute with no pair is not transferred -- the cascade would carry it through as an inert, in silence, and report a gas it never washed (or a liquid it never stripped) at exit 0.

A feed failing `nonSoluteInTheLiquid` -- The cascade moves SOLUTES (`role solute;` with a Henry pair against the solvent) between the phases, holds the solvent in the liquid and every other component in the gas.  It has no rule for a non-solute that arrives in the LIQUID (absorbed, stripped or carried through are three different answers, and Kremser makes none of them), so that component would leave in neither outlet.  A TRACE (below 1e-12 of the stream) is carried through.

A feed failing `solventInTheStrippingGas` -- The cascade holds the solvent in the liquid and has no rule for solvent that arrives as VAPOUR (steam stripping, if the solvent is water): whether it condenses and pays the stripping heat or passes overhead is the solvent's own vapour-liquid equilibrium, which a Kremser cascade on Henry's law does not solve, so that solvent would leave in neither outlet.

turbine.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the inlet, as one vapour mixture priced by the package's enthalpy and entropy.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
refuses: A feed that is not a vapour -- The turbine prices its inlet and its isentropic path with the VAPOUR root of the package at the overall composition and publishes its outlet as a vapour; a liquid or two-phase inlet would be expanded as if it were all vapour, hiding the latent heat of its liquid.

valve.judged: each process inlet, before any unit runs when the inlet is authored, else at the unit's own solve
models: Every component of the feed, throttled isenthalpically: the outlet is the package's equilibrium at the lower pressure carrying the inlet's enthalpy, in whatever phase the feed is.
mayPass: Nothing: no pass-through is offered, so every component it is handed enters its equations or is refused.
